# Sign-off templates (§6.1 / §7)

Replace bracketed fields; store completed copies in your ticket system (not necessarily in git).

## Clinical rubric — stakeholder sign-off

- **Note types in scope:** [e.g. progress note, problem list]
- **Rubric document:** [link to `evals/rubrics/note_quality.md` or successor]
- **Reviewer name & role:** [name], [role]
- **Date:** [YYYY-MM-DD]
- **Attestation:** I confirm the rubric is appropriate for the above note types for this release/pilot.

_Signature / electronic approval reference:_ […]

## Delegated reviewer — user-facing wording / structure

- **Change summary:** [prompt version / UI copy / workflow step]
- **Risk class:** [low / medium / high]
- **Reviewer:** [name], [delegated authority]
- **Date:** [YYYY-MM-DD]
- **Outcome:** [approved / approved with edits / rejected]

_Reference (PR, doc, or ticket):_ […]
